review_rationale: batch108: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read all 20 base units of 10.2.2.3, 10.2.2.4 and 10.2.2.5 in the original PDF across pages 193 to 198, verified 20 base / 46 fine units, 20 requirements and 64 facets (all pending), and confirmed by independent script that every base and fine unit is accounted exactly once with no missing, extra or duplicate row. The zero-numbered-items claim was verified independently: R1034 through R1041 and C1016 through C1034 all live in 10.2.2.2, so no numbered item falls in this scope and all 20 base units are newly accounted. The ownership boundary against 10.2.2.1 and 10.2.2.2, which were authored in parallel, was checked in both directions and found free of duplication and of gaps: the bounds-remapping effects of p8 through p10 are correctly owned here while the bounds syntax and count constraints stay with 10.2.2.2. 10.2.2.5 correctly yields zero requirements and zero facets because it is examples, with both base units and all three fine units still accounted. Three permission dispositions were adjudicated and accepted, all in 10.2.2.4 p3, where each pure, simple and elemental-intrinsic target exception is an allowed exception rather than an obligation; no other unit in scope grants latitude and no requirement was demoted. The attribution table was audited against the source rather than accepted, including the p7 VOLATILE if-and-only-if family, the three separate p8 families, and the opposite implicit-interface pairs of 10.2.2.4 p5. Pointer discipline was verified: the plans for the p2 remote-image undefined status, the p5 undefined-status target exclusion and the p8 undefined remap target do not read, compare, inquire about or otherwise observe a pointer after its association status becomes undefined, and that unobservability claim is scoped to undefined association status only rather than overbroad. Bounds evidence is non-vacuous, calling for nondefault lower bounds, remapped shapes differing from the target shape, and target lower bounds distinct from the explicit ones, and ASSOCIATED, LBOUND, UBOUND and SHAPE are tied to source text that directly specifies association, bounds, extents or shape with the 16.9 intrinsics kept as dependencies rather than as definitions. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings; two non-blocking observations recorded in doc/source_audits/batch_108.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
